title: Keep Angular components focused and externally templated
statement: Keep a component focused on one view responsibility. Use templateUrl and styleUrl for non-trivial views, inject dependencies explicitly, and expose narrow typed inputs and outputs.
rationale: Focused view classes such as Quality Studio's ProjectDashboardView keep rendering, navigation, and data services separable and make component tests cheaper to understand.

examples.bad:
@Component({ selector: 'qs-dashboard', template: '<section>...</section>', styles: ['...'] })
export class Dashboard { /* data access, formatting, navigation, and rendering */ }

history.change: Initial Angular component-structure seed grounded in Quality Studio views.
